facts.fact: Communications minister Samuel Nartey George said the government's One Million Coders Programme, which trains Ghanaians in digital skills, had 141,954 registered accounts and 27,782 active learners as of 2 August 2026.

Minister Samuel Nartey George said the One Million Coders Programme had recorded 5,812 course completions and 11,683 cumulative attendances across 118 reporting centres between 1 June and 15 August 2026.
